name: Let Dreaming Androids Lie
source:
This story centers around the relationship of an android and her creator, exploring trauma and what it means to be a human from the eyes of a machine created to imitate one.

[Edited from [url=https://bsky.app/profile/livienvi.bsky.social/post/3mqewaf4jrk2d]Bluesky post[/url]]
translation:
这个故事围绕着一个机器人和她的创造者的关系展开，从一台模仿人类的机器的角度探索创伤以及作为人类意味着什么。

[编辑自[url=https://bsky.app/profile/livienvi.bsky.social/post/3mqewaf4jrk2d]Bluesky帖子[/url]]
